bolao.tiebreaker: ⚠️ Ranking Tiebreaker: If two or more participants finish with the same total points, positions will be decided sequentially by:
bolao.step1: 1. Login or Register: Go to the 🎯 Bets tab. If it's your first time, enter your name, create a password, and click Register.
bolao.step2: 2. Place Bets: After logging in, the active games' goal fields will be unlocked. Enter your predicted score.
bolao.step3: 3. Time Lock: You can only save or change bets until the official match start time.
bolao.step4: 4. Individual Check: On the 📋 My Bets tab, select your name from the dropdown to see a clean report of your bets.
bolao.step5: 5. Monitor Standings: Track your progress on the 🏆 Ranking tab. It updates automatically!

album.desc1: Hitting bets rewards sticker packs. The rarity chances apply per drawn sticker:
album.sp1: Wildcard 🃏 — Click it in your inventory to transform it into any common or rare sticker.
album.sp2: Italy 🇮🇹 (Tradition) — Appears in very rare events (1%). Grants a passive +1% chance for Rares in all packs.
album.sp3: 2026 Trophy 🏆 — Earned by completing the normal album. Grants a passive +10% extra sticker chance.
album.tr1: How it works: Propose trades offering up to 5 duplicate stickers for up to 5 from a colleague.
album.tr2: Protected stickers: Upon completing the album, 1 copy of each sticker is permanently locked (🔒).
album.tr3: Partnership Bonus: The first completed trade with each friend has a 0.8% rare chance to give both a secret server prize!
album.desc4: Sacrifice 3 duplicate stickers to create a new one. The sacrifice rarity defines the chances:
album.synCat: 🧪 Catalyst (optional): Add 1 common sticker to the extra slot to boost — +2% per common and +5% per rare.
album.desc5: By completing the 2026 Album you unlock the Legacy Album, a special collection dedicated to the 1970 Mexico World Cup with the Jules Rimet Trophy.
album.leg1: Legacy Stickers automatically appear in normal packs once unlocked.
album.leg2: Argentina 70 (Legacy Tradition) — Passive: 5% chance to win a bonus Rare Legacy Sticker in any pack.
album.leg3: Brazil 70 (Legendary) — The rarest sticker. Can only drop in packs or via Legacy Forge.
album.leg4: Jules Rimet Trophy 🏆 — Earned by completing the Legacy Album. Passive +10% extra sticker chance.
album.desc6: The Forge is the Synthesis Machine exclusive to the Legacy Album:
album.forRisk: ⚠️ Risk Slot (optional): Add 1 Legacy Common to boost — but there is a 35% chance to explode and lose everything.

simulador.desc1: The Simulator allows you to build your own World Cup bracket by picking the winners from the Round of 32 to the Grand Final.
simulador.step2: Step 2: Click the team you believe will win each match to advance them.
simulador.step3: Step 3: Build your simulation until you pick the Champion.
simulador.step4: Step 4: Click Save Simulation. You can only do this before the first Round of 32 match begins.
simulador.step5: Finished matches: Real winners are locked in the bracket with a gold border.
simulador.pts1: Correct team advancing in Round of 32
